title: Recessed Toilet Paper Holder 6.125-Inch Square | Satin Nickel | Carolina | Allied Brass
short_title: Recessed Toilet Paper Holder 6.125-Inch Square, Satin Nickel
description:
Free up elbow room around the toilet with a built-in look that keeps the paper right where you need it in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms. This recessed toilet paper holder from the Carolina collection brings traditional bathroom hardware styling to a clean, in-wall installation for a finished, coordinated bath.

Highlights:
- Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate a cohesive bath with the Carolina collection, designed for classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures
- Install with confidence: coordinating mounting hardware is included for easier setup

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 6.125 x 6.125 x 4 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 6 x 4 in.
- Shipping weight: 2.4 lbs
- Mounting: recessed/in-wall with concealed screw mounting; all mounting hardware included
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
multiple designer finish options available
